Join our team as a SAP SD Consulting Team Lead! We are looking for an individual to lead a group of consultants responsible for Sales Order Management processes. If you have extensive experience in SAP SD and the ability to motivate a team, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

  • Communicate effectively with clients to gather requirements and understand business processes
  • Design solutions, create specifications, make customizations to the system, and test them
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure successful project delivery

Requirements

  • SAP SD consulting experience of 10+ years, including strong expertise in topics such as contracts, call-offs, and ATP
  • Ability to lead a team of 5-8 consultants
  • Readiness to work hands-on as a consultant
  • S/4HANA experience
  • Working experience with SAP AFS is a significant plus
  • Excellent communication, prioritization, time management, and stakeholder management skills
  • English language proficiency at a B2+ level
  • Ability to work remotely with regular trips to Stuttgart/Germany - 3 days monthly

Nice to have

  • Experience in the fashion industry
